goal: Reduce the target class's fan-out by extracting the large resolveDeclaration implementation and its closely related parameter-resolution helpers into a new delegate class. This removes direct dependencies on JavaParserFactory and java.util.Optional from the target and consolidates the heavy use of JavaParserFacade into the new class, resulting in a net reduction of 2-4 outgoing dependencies.

ops.details: Create a new class JavaSymbolSolverResolver in the same package and extract the implementation of resolveDeclaration(Node, Class<T>) and the three private resolveParameterDeclaration(...) overloads into it. The extracted implementation retains references to JavaParserFacade and JavaParserFactory and returns the same types. The original JavaSymbolSolver.resolveDeclaration will be replaced by a thin delegating method that forwards calls to an instance of JavaSymbolSolverResolver (injected or created using the existing typeSolver field). This moves all codepaths that used JavaParserFactory and java.util.Optional into the new class so those imports/usages can be removed from the original class.

Move the full implementation (all instanceof branches and logic) of the generic resolveDeclaration method into the new resolver class. Leave in JavaSymbolSolver a delegating stub with the original signature that calls the new instance's method so external callers and the SymbolResolver interface remain satisfied.

Move the private helper resolving method that walks method-like declarations into the new class. This helper is only consumed by resolveDeclaration; moving it keeps related code together and eliminates Optional usage from the original class.
Move the private helper that resolves record parameters into the new class together with the other parameter-resolution helpers.

Move the private helper that resolves lambda/catch clause parameters into the new class. This method uses JavaParserFactory.getContext(...) and Optional and so moving it removes those dependencies from the original class.

outputs: updated imports in JavaSymbolSolver.java (removing java.util.Optional and JavaParserFactory/JavaParserFacade if no longer used)
ops.details: Update imports so the extracted class has the imports it needs (JavaParserFacade, JavaParserFactory, Optional and other resolved types) and the original JavaSymbolSolver removes imports that are no longer used after extraction.

inputs: internal calls in JavaSymbolSolver to the moved helpers (previously direct calls now inside moved method)
outputs: JavaSymbolSolver now delegates to an instance of JavaSymbolSolverResolver for resolveDeclaration and parameter-resolution helpers
ops.details: Replace internal direct implementation with delegation: in JavaSymbolSolver the resolveDeclaration method becomes a simple forwarder to javaSymbolSolverResolver.resolveDeclaration(node, resultClass). Ensure the resolver instance is created or injected using the existing typeSolver (e.g. new JavaSymbolSolverResolver(typeSolver)) so no new external state is required. Update any internal references accordingly.
